run_healthcheck_endpoint: run the healthcheck endpoint to verify the service is responding with 'ok'
test_healthcheck_endpoint: test the healthcheck endpoint returns a plain text response with status ok
review_healthcheck_endpoint: review the healthcheck endpoint that logs /healthcheck and returns PlainTextResponse
summarize_healthcheck_endpoint: summarize the healthcheck endpoint that responds to requests with 'ok' and no-store cache header
refactor_healthcheck_endpoint: refactor the healthcheck endpoint to add additional health status checks beyond returning 'ok'
